name: furniture
description: Furniture atlas (家具图鉴): 15 classic MC furniture pieces from one generator — bed/table/chair/stool/sofa/bookshelf/cabinet/kitchen_counter/desk/lamp_post/flower_pot/bench/dresser/fireplace/piano. All recipes are build-circle canon (fence+pressure_plate table, stair+sign chair, stair-row sofa, barrel cabinets, campfire fireplace ...). Direction states (stair facing/half, sign rotation, bed part) are derived from origin+facing by the script.
when_to_use: Interior furnishing after walls/roof are done. origin = the piece's bottom-FRONT-left cell at floor level (the block the furniture stands in, not under); facing = the direction the FRONT faces (where the user stands; for seats: the way the sitter faces; for bed: foot->head, i.e. where the pillow points). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half/rotation/part in the output; change params and re-run (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 室内家具/软装:卧室(bed/dresser/bookshelf)、客厅(sofa/table/chair/stool/bench/lamp_post/flower_pot/piano)、书房(desk/bookshelf)、厨房(kitchen_counter/cabinet)、壁炉客厅(fireplace)

origin.notes: bottom-front-left cell at floor level; y = the layer the piece stands in

facing.notes: front direction (seats: sitter's view; bed: foot->head); rotation is derived, never hand-filled

extra.notes: each piece accepts the extra params listed under pieces.<name>.extra_params; all have safe defaults

bed.recipe: REAL bed block: minecraft:<color>_bed, two cells — part=foot at origin, part=head one cell forward; both share the same facing (foot->head).

extra_params.color: any of the 16 bed colors, default red

pitfalls: 禁止用两格羊毛/混凝土冒充床 —— 必须用真床方块(color_bed, part=foot/head),这是本项目的耻辱柱错误
facing 两格必须一致,head 在 facing 方向上一格;放反了枕头就在脚那头
床头那格前方必须是空气,否则放置失败

table.recipe: fence leg(s) + pressure-plate top (classic 1x1 side table; width 2-4 = dining table).
pitfalls: 桌面用 pressure_plate 不是 carpet —— carpet 会陷进栅栏顶的视觉缝
width>1 时每格一条腿,不要只放两端腿(中间桌面悬空难看)

chair.recipe: one stair (back at the rear: stair facing = OPPOSITE of the sitter's view) + two standing signs beside it as armrests.
pitfalls: 楼梯 facing 必须与'坐的人看的方向'相反(facing=高侧/靠背),放反了人面朝靠背
扶手用站立 sign(rotation 由脚本推导),不要用墙挂 sign

stool.recipe: a single bare stair, no armrests.
pitfalls: stool 不是'没扶手的小椅子'之外的任何东西 —— 别加靠背第二格;要靠背请用 chair/sofa

sofa.recipe: row of seat stairs (backs at rear) + one end stair at each side rotated 90°, tall side OUTWARD = chunky armrests.
pitfalls: 扶手端楼梯必须背朝外(高侧在外),放反了扶手变成向外下斜的坡
整排座位楼梯共享一个 facing(=坐的反面),别逐格改

bookshelf.recipe: plain minecraft:bookshelf grid; texture is rotation-blind so facing is irrelevant.
pitfalls: 用 minecraft:bookshelf 不是 chiseled_bookshelf(后者纹理是空格子,不放书像烂柜)
别超过 4 高,再高像墙不像家具

cabinet.recipe: barrel grid with lids facing out — the lid reads as a cupboard door.
pitfalls: barrel 必须 facing=正面(桶盖当柜门);朝上的桶盖读作木墩不是柜门
别和 chest 混用:chest 会两两合并成大箱子,破坏网格

kitchen_counter.use_for: 厨房操作台(水槽+台面+炉灶)
kitchen_counter.recipe: cauldron sink + upside-down stair counter run (half=top, flat cabinet face toward the front) + smoker oven.
pitfalls: 台面楼梯必须 half=top(倒放),正放会在台面上留出台阶缺角
炉灶用 smoker 不是 furnace —— smoker 才是灶;水槽用 cauldron,空锅即是经典水槽

desk.recipe: upside-down stair writing desk + lectern with an open book on top.
pitfalls: 同 kitchen_counter:桌体楼梯 half=top
lectern 必须放在桌体正上方(脚本保证),手挪一格就悬空
灯放栅栏柱顶上,不要贴墙挂(那是 wall_torch 的活)
height 不要超过 4,再高是路灯不是落地灯

flower_pot.recipe: potted plant block (flower_pot + plant = minecraft:potted_<plant>); pedestal=true lifts it on a fence-post plant stand.

extra_params.plant: flower id without prefix, default red_tulip (dandelion/poppy/blue_orchid/allium/azure_bluet/*_tulip/oxeye_daisy/cornflower/lily_of_the_valley)
extra_params.pedestal: true = spruce_fence 底座, default false

pitfalls: 盆栽是 minecraft:potted_<plant> 独立方块,不是 flower_pot 上面叠一朵花(那样花会悬空)
别放在半砖/地毯上,盆会视觉下沉

bench.recipe: row of bottom slabs + standing-sign armrests at both ends.
pitfalls: 椅面 slab 必须 type=bottom 贴地,放成 top 会悬出一道缝
要靠背用 sofa;bench 就是无靠背款

dresser.recipe: tall barrel column grid (lids = drawer fronts) + slab top surface for decorations.
pitfalls: 同 cabinet:barrel 盖子朝正面;dresser 比 cabinet 高(height>=2,默认 3),别搞反
顶面 slab 是 type=bottom 搁在桶上,不是悬空 top slab

fireplace.recipe: campfire firebox between brick jambs + upside-down stair lintel (arch over the fire, half=top) + brick breast + 1-wide chimney column.
pitfalls: 火用 campfire[facing=正面],不要用 netherrack 点火(火会乱窜且不符合居住安全惯例)
过梁楼梯 half=top 架在 campfire 正上方形成拱口;别用整砖封死(火被埋)也别留空(门楣悬空)
烟囱道从壁炉正上方直通屋顶,别半路拐弯

piano.recipe: upright: dark body (dark_oak_planks), white_concrete keys strip facing the player, stair lid sloping toward the player.
pitfalls: 琴键(白色一格)必须在 facing 正面且被两侧琴身夹住,朝后就成白板
这是立式钢琴;三角钢琴体积远超 3 格,别用这个凑
床必须用真床方块(red_bed 等, part=foot/head)——上一版用两格羊毛冒充床,已成项目耻辱柱,严禁再犯
所有朝向状态(stair facing/half、sign rotation、bed part、barrel/smoker/campfire facing)由脚本从 origin+facing 推导,禁止手填或手改输出 JSON
坐具楼梯 facing = 坐向的反面(facing=高侧/靠背,见 stair_orientations.md)
台面/桌面用 half=top 倒放楼梯;座面用 half=bottom 正放楼梯/半砖贴地
家具不浮空:每件都有落地支撑路径(栅栏腿/桶身/楼梯贴地),跑 support_check 验证
example: python patterns/furniture.py --params '{"piece":"bed","origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"east"}' --out bed.json && python patterns/furniture.py --params '{"piece":"sofa","origin":[100,64,110],"facing":"south","length":4}' --out sofa.json
